name: webcam-builtin
title: Built-in Camera
description: Registers the printer's built-in MIPI camera as a Moonraker [webcam] entry, so Fluidd and Mainsail show it alongside any other configured camera. WebRTC stream from /webcam/webrtc, JPEG snapshots from /webcam/snapshot.jpg. Requires the Camera HW Accel plugin to actually serve those URLs.
tagline: Show the built-in MIPI camera in Fluidd & Mainsail.

variables.name: BUILTIN_CAMERA_NAME
variables.description: Display name for the built-in camera in Fluidd/Mainsail (e.g. "Built-in", "Toolhead", "Side").

config.label: Camera name in Fluidd/Mainsail
config.hint: Whatever you want it called in the UI: Built-in, Toolhead, Side, etc.
